detail.requirements:
• 10+ years of live broadcast remote operations experience (preferably network level) in a coordination or supervisory role
• Familiarity with digital audio/video fundamentals, compression technologies, distribution formats, and associated technologies such as Multicast and Unicast video distribution, MPEG Video (2, 4, & HEVC), MPEG-2 TS, HDR, SCTE-35 & ESNI signaling, closed-captions, satellite video distribution, and ad-splicing
• Familiarity with video transport protocols such as SDI, SMPTE-2110, RTP, RTMP, SRT, Zixi, RIST, HLS, MPEG-DASH
• Familiarity with Video and Audio Compression technology
• Understanding of nuances of remote production and the on-site technical operation
• Knowledge of remote production facilities and equipment vendors
• Familiarity with MVPD-based linear ecosystems and working knowledge of OTT video distribution, contribution technology, and architecture
• Ability to assess and troubleshoot video and audio quality
• Experience with on-premise video acquisition with partners or co-location facilities
• Fluency in English, Japanese and/or Korean is required
detail.main_tasks:
• Coordination and partnership across multiple stakeholders and clients for the smooth execution of live-streaming events
• Help draft, finalize, and maintain our Live Production Handbook that outlines key and critical technical and general guidelines for producing live content for Netflix
• Collaborate with contractors and in-house engineers for transmission planning
• Establish and maintain partnerships with satellite and IP transmission vendors, including estimating and booking of transmission pathways
• Establish and maintain partnerships with hardware and broadcast companies such as contribution/distribution encoder vendors, closed-captioning gears, and services
• Organize and maintain ground plans & drawings of venue infrastructures; draft and publish a detailed Technical Specifications booklet
• Act as a central resource for engineering and production, collaborating with teams to develop and execute technical plans, often managing concurrent schedules
• Responsible for troubleshooting, diagnosing, and reporting audio, video, and infrastructure issues in close collaboration with Netflix Engineering Team
• Participate in managing and evolving ground ingest capabilities, including signal acquisition, inspection, validation, and standardization
• Monitor the industry for emerging technologies and developing trends
• Be present on location for scouts/site visits, ESU, rehearsals, and actual live events; work flexible hours based on live events schedule
• Assume the role of lead Tech Manager or coordinate with freelance Tech Managers for larger-scale events
• Determine the best transmission method and coordinate with remote origination locations to ensure technical quality and readiness for air
• Work with other television entities, outside broadcasters, and vendors to identify, negotiate for, and secure required resources
• Maintain technical and broadcast quality including HDR, 4K, HD, Dolby or Stereo; work with production partners on hiring and managing technical crew
detail.intro: Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. In this role, you will manage project-based live TV streaming technical operations for Netflix. Leading Live TV Technical Operations, you will help plan and execute all live project-based technical operations and work in collaboration with the Directors of Unscripted/ Live Content, Post Production, Live Streaming Pipeline Engineering Team and project/partner Production teams, and our Reliability Engineering teams.

job.position: Manager, Live TV Technical Operations, APAC
